reason: On exact private IME9804, original GTK TextView and Entry focus_return retain the typed word before focus-away but lose it before the gesture after focus-return. The current preedit publisher always sets PREEDIT_CLEAR. IBus bus/inputcontext.c focus_out and client/gtk2/ibusimcontext.c clear_preedit_text preserve visible composition only for PREEDIT_COMMIT. A hint is already split into auxiliary display on legacy transport.
decision: Use the existing IBus PREEDIT_COMMIT flag only for a nonempty exact current legacy typed composition: exact tail/buffer mirror, payload equals buffer, live reducer token matches word scope, no sealed handoff, sensitive content or active Atomic path. Retain PREEDIT_CLEAR for all other payloads and explicit empty/hide. Publish no CommitText after FocusOut, inherit no old word authority, add no client-specific route or owner. UnknownStart is not promoted: preserving the user's already typed letters is not permission to edit committed text.
